body:
Schema 21 tests queried Operational jobs/progress and Search projections through Core, hiding valid behavior behind missing-table errors. This completes the fixture corrections, retains the behavioral assertions, adds real lifecycle/physical-boundary regressions, and records independent integration verification. The stacked production correction in #91 prevents historical Search documents from entering a newly rebuilt generation.

Depends on #93 → #91; this PR's base is `fix/schema21-job-search-runtime`. Public Schema 21 stays separate from opt-in P1–P7. No DDL, compatibility views, aliases, implicit ATTACH, shadow tables, migration or P7 activation is introduced.

### Exact revision and results

- Final evidence HEAD: `94488cf4e7fa15f747ece7a4e3d57e0bc213966a`; tree: `a63fd1ea38fd22f6b45843cc60129fd946c563c6`.

- **3495 passed / 1 failed / 0 errors**, selected 3496. JUnit, unique starts and 10488 setup/call/teardown records reconcile exactly.
- **228/228 inherited runtime failures plus one main-only fencing failure resolved**; all five new regressions and 937 P1–P6/compatibility nodes passed. The 228-row classification records actual unchanged-main reproductions, store ownership, layered causes, fix PR and independent outcomes.
- Remaining failure: `tests/unit/test_build_docs_site.py::test_staging_allowlist_and_transformation`, missing `chrome-headless-shell (155.0.8059.79)`. No browser download/policy bypass. No complete-repository pass or release acceptance claimed.
- Default live/stress marker policy unchanged; two excluded nodes remain unexecuted. No skip/xfail added.
- Initial unchanged-main complete run: 2848 passed / 332 failed / 311 errors, contaminated by temporary-storage exhaustion. Workspace retries reconcile 3491 unique nodes to 3261 passed / 230 failed / 0 errors; this is explicitly a multi-run reconciliation, not a successful clean full run.
- Reviewer A approved architecture; B verified lifecycle and a combined 304-node P7/compatibility cohort; C independently verified all 228 inherited nodes and five regressions, including transparent retries; D approved baseline, full-run journal, distribution and final-HEAD binding.
- Real wheel and wheel-from-sdist execution outside checkout: two CLI tests and four installed Search regressions passed. Both wheel hashes: `acae0607661bff850b7c2d58d561edfcf12319f06a01e09ea3f604114468a235`; 120 packaged inputs match the final source.
- Current boundary/schema/publication audits and Ruff check/format passed. The optional obsolete phase2 helper still references removed `exchange.EXCLUDED`; it is unchanged from main and is not reported as passing.
- The future combined tree containing #89 passed all eight documentation unit tests. This separate result does not rewrite the full-run failure or claim a combined full-suite pass.
